assertion_analysis.fails_if: The subprocess exits before or during either observed live-stream interval.
The subprocess fails to create initial progress or append further progress before the bounded deadline.
Restoring the unconditional REQUESTED pointer transition changes the live pointer to promotion-requested; the recorded base run fails at line 60 in both cases.
A request is marked started before readiness instead of being parked without a promotion attempt.
The service launches a promotion while the real worker is still alive.
The live request is refused or run rather than parked in WAITING.

A later tick, duplicate request, or final promotion replaces the server-generated request identity; the expectation comes from the earlier returned receipt, not an input supplied to request_promotion.
The service writes a premature promotion ledger row while the reviewer remains live.
Removing WAITING from request_promotion's deduplication set creates a fresh request rather than acknowledging the original.
The controlled reviewer fails or times out instead of exiting successfully when signalled.
The service launches after worker exit while the manifest still reads in-progress, as restoring the extra process-alive condition permits.
An incomplete manifest permits pointer transition or a started_at receipt after the worker exits.
Removing WAITING from _pending_requests prevents the original parked request from launching once the manifest becomes complete.
Removing WAITING from PromotionService._run's accepted phases abandons the launched request rather than producing a promoted receipt.
Promotion leaves the live pointer behind instead of retiring the completed run.
The ledger contains zero or multiple rows, or records a promotion mechanism other than review-self.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares an injected expected value against that same injected value; request-id comparisons assert continuity of an identity generated by the production request writer, while phase, liveness, launch, and ledger expectations are independently observed.
failure_parser_positive_control: The same gate_log_failure_ids reader detects both parametrized failures in negative-control-final.log before zero added failures is recorded.

item_verdicts.diff: read commits 68f08e0b1aa849b9f2ae90f1cbc8d8731a3405e5, 897a1b2b6ce362041d2d82f21ae74e6fd7f1c4f9, and 83d42b81ee65f06e8c5313e2136cdb8d305a50ae against the recorded base; they contain the queue repair, its subprocess regression, a readiness fixture correction, and the required evidence fragments.
item_verdicts.done_when: the source prompt requires a real live reviewer, no early promotion, and eventual promotion of the same request; tests/test_a_working_review_keeps_its_working_phase.py:20-104 asserts those conditions and regression.log records 2 passed at the reviewed head.
item_verdicts.goal: the source prompt requires a working review to retain its phase until delivery; reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:230 consults the existing readiness verdict before changing that phase and lines 473 and 790 reconsider the parked request.
item_verdicts.manifest: the source manifest names all three commits and readable gate receipts; baseline.log and after.log each report 58 passed with EXIT=0, regression.log reports 2 passed, and negative-control-final.log records both expected base failures.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source prompt permits reckon, tests, and the named evidence-fragment directory; all five changed paths shown by the three reviewed commits lie within those declarations.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_working_review_keeps_its_working_phase.py:60-97 independently reads pointer, request, and ledger state, so reinstating the early pointer transition, dropping WAITING from the queue, or regenerating a parked request makes its corresponding assertion fail.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_working_review_keeps_its_working_phase.py:60 fails twice against the base with promotion-requested observed instead of working, while regression.log records both cases passing at the reviewed head and the baseline/after logs support zero added failures.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:310 delegates readiness to the existing acceptance owner and consistently uses the existing QUEUED vocabulary without adding forbidden source identifiers or commentary.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:230 preserves the previous working phase while review_self_state waits, and lines 473 and 790 retain parked requests for promotion after readiness changes.
justifications.reuse: no production definition was added, and the added regression in tests/test_a_working_review_keeps_its_working_phase.py:20 extends the existing request/readiness capability using the opened fixtures from tests/test_review_promotion_waits_for_its_record.py rather than duplicating its repository, pointer, record, or exit helpers.
justifications.scope_discipline: the changes to reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py, the two test files, and the two evidence fragments are within the source prompt's declared paths and each supports the specified phase repair or its recorded gate.
